role: The combined "Daily Report" PDF: renders two unique cover pages (Today in one glance; Why your score) to a temp PDF, renders the WorkoutPDFReport to another temp, and merges them with PDFKit into the destination; also holds the training-load source for the report and builds the shared DailyLoopAnalysis.
types: HolisticDailyReport: final class (Sendable) — immutable report inputs plus generation entry point; extended by +Pages.swift and +Score.swift
HolisticDailyReport.Config: struct — page size 612x792, 36pt margin, fonts and colours (primary/sage/amber/text/divider)
toplevel: Config stored-property initializers create UIFonts/UIColors at construction. Constructed by ReportsListView.renderHolistic (ReportsListView.swift:392), MainTabView+Reports.renderDailyReport (MainTabView+Reports.swift:113) and WorkoutRecorder+Metrics.holisticReport (WorkoutRecorder+Metrics.swift:444), plus EmuquTests/WorkoutReportSmokeTests.swift:214 and TrainingAdviceGateTests.

flags.text: Header comment (lines 24-27) and the overnightSession doc (57-58) say a nil overnight session makes the output drop to just the WorkoutPDFReport pages; this class never does that — it always draws the cover pages, with a "No morning data" row (HolisticDailyReport+Pages.swift:236-237). The fallback exists only in callers (WorkoutRecorder+Metrics.swift:422, MainTabView+Reports.swift:110-112).

TrainingLoadRegistry's surface table says the Holistic Daily Report draws no disclosure ("none drawn"), but drawLoadAsOf draws liveLoadSnapshot.disclosure ("Live · updated …") at the top right of page 1 whenever a live snapshot is present.

units.does: Stores all inputs; keeps liveLoadSnapshot only when the workout (endDate, else startDate) is today in the current calendar, so a past day's report uses the frozen session load.

branches.effect: ?? falls back to startDate for the "is today" test
stores the passed liveLoadSnapshot; otherwise stores nil

flags.text: docs/TRAINING_LOAD.md says the PDF/holistic reports read cache.current (the live numbers), but the initializer drops the caller-captured live snapshot unless the workout ended today. Any past-day daily report prints the frozen session load and gates advice on it.

units.does: Async entry point: renders the workout PDF to a temp file, then the two cover pages to another temp, merges cover-then-workout into `url`, and removes both temps via defer whatever happens after each exists.
Deletes a temp file if it exists, logging (not throwing) a removal failure via attempt("HolisticDailyReport.remove").

branches.effect: returns without doing anything; otherwise removes it, swallowing (logging) any error

units.does: Builds a WorkoutPDFReport from the session/track/HR settings/units and renders it to <tmp>/holistic-workout-<8>.pdf; on failure removes the temp and rethrows; returns the temp URL.

branches.effect: removes the temp then rethrows; otherwise returns the URL

units.does: Renders page 1 (Today in one glance) and page 2 (Why your score) with UIGraphicsPDFRenderer to <tmp>/holistic-cover-<8>.pdf; on failure removes it and rethrows.

branches.effect: removes the temp and rethrows; otherwise returns the URL

units.does: Opens both temps as PDFDocuments, appends cover pages then workout pages into a new PDFDocument and writes it to `url`; if either temp fails to open or the combined write fails, logs a warning and copies the workout-only PDF to `url`.

branches.effect: logs a warning (re-opening both temps to report which failed) and copies the workout PDF to url, returning — the cover pages are dropped with no user-visible signal; otherwise merges
logs a warning and copies the workout-only PDF to url; if write left a file at url, copyItem throws and the error propagates

flags.text: On either fallback the user receives a workout-only PDF titled as a daily report, with the recovery/loop and score pages missing; the only signal is a debugLog warning.

units.does: Inserts every page of `doc` into `combined` starting at `index`, skipping pages PDFKit cannot return, and returns the next index.

branches.cond: for each page index of doc

units.does: Returns the training-load context the report prints: when a live snapshot exists, a TrainingContext with live ATL/CTL/TSB and the workout session's frozen yesterdayTrimp/vo2Max/daysSinceHardWorkout/recentWorkouts; else the workout session's frozen trainingSnapshot, else the overnight session's.

branches.effect: builds a context from live ATL/CTL/TSB; otherwise falls back to frozen snapshots
yesterdayTrimp ?? 0 — 0 is used; vo2Max/daysSinceHardWorkout/recentWorkouts become nil (the overnight session snapshot is not consulted on this path)
?? overnightSession?.trainingSnapshot; nil when neither has one

flags.text: The crash-guard comments name `WorkoutRecorder+Lifecycle.generateHolisticReport` as the detached render path. No such function exists anywhere in the repo. The real callers are WorkoutRecorder+Metrics.renderCoachReportPDF/holisticReport, ReportsListView.renderHolistic and MainTabView+Reports.renderDailyReport.

units.does: Returns liveLoadSnapshot?.disclosure ("Live · updated <time>"), nil when there is no live snapshot (past day or cold cache).

Builds a fresh DailyLoopAnalysis from the workout, the overnight session, the recent overnight sessions that started on or before the reported night (overnight start, else workout start), max HR and the advice-gate load.

flags.text: analysis() constructs a new DailyLoopAnalysis (filtering sessions and recomputing the ln-RMSSD baseline each time a property is read) on every call; one page render calls it about ten times (drawGlanceHero, morningHRVRow, workoutInternalLoadRow, loopParagraph, tomorrowAction, whatsHelpingPoints twice via drawHelpingHurting, hurtingHRVPoints, legacyHRVContribution twice). The doc comment says it is built once per render.

units.does: Maps a DailyLoopAnalysis verdict tone to a PDF colour.
